text:
Asha: Okay team — quiet window starts in 45m. quick checklist ping before we lock. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Ben: Ack. infra freeze confirmed. only emergency patches allowed, must go through #eng-oncall and have a rollback plan.
Carlos: Release notes live: https://internal.redwood/releases/2026-03-22-changes — put customers (EU) notice under 'communications' section.
Lee: Product confirms no feature flags toggled during window. we'll validate UI smoke at 20% traffic.
DeployBot: Deployment request queued: rollout-8612 -> backend:v2026.03.22-beta. Status: queued.
Asha: Pin policy: we will pin stable images to v2026.03.21 for 30m post-rollout. no automatic re-pin.
Ben: Monitoring owners: Ben/Carlos on metrics, Lee on UX, Asha holds rollback key. Pager routing set to @Pager.
Carlos: Rollback triggers (agreed):
- spike: >1.0% errors sustained 3m OR
- latency p95 > 300ms above baseline for 5m OR
- critical frontend error flagged by Lee.
Asha: If triggered, execute rollback + unpin and open incident. quick commands below.
Carlos: Rollback snippet for copy:
```
# quick rollback to last stable image
kubectl rollout undo deployment/backend --to-revision=3 --namespace=prod
# deploybot helper
deploybot revert rollout-8612 --target v2026.03.21
```
Lee: Canary plan: 0% -> 3% (5m) -> 15% (15m) -> 50% (20m) -> 100% (10m). 10m hold checks between each step.
Ben: Alert set: error-rate-3m, latency-p95-10m, auth-fail-rate. thresholds pushed to Pager.
Asha: Config knobs: quant-mode=none, batch-window=40ms, cache-ttl=30s for first 45m.
DeployBot: Preflight results: lint=config OK, infra-health OK, smoke=running.
Carlos: Smoke logs: "worker warmup 2/3" — expected transient, continue to watch.
Lee: UX smoke: basic flows pass on canary at 3%. screenshots attached in thread.
Asha: Reminder: no docs edits allowed unless emergency. all public-facing notes must go through communications after 15m stable at 100%.
Ben: I'll start the ramp at T-minus 30m unless someone calls hold. call out here to abort.
Lee: Holding criteria noted. Product will thumbs-up in the 20m hold.
Pager: Routing check complete. escalation -> Pager -> oncall-lead -> eng-manager.
Asha: GO in 10. post a single-line "GO" to kick the rollout.
Ben: GO
DeployBot: Canary started -> 3% traffic. job rollout-8612 progressing.
Asha: Watching dashboards now. tagging @Lee @Carlos for visibility.
